changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A removed source of a workspace. Workspace tenancy, not an owner policy, scopes it, so a removal by one person makes the records of every person that cite the source stale.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE public.source_tombstone ( workspace_id bigint NOT NULL, source_kind varchar(16) NOT NULL, source_id uuid NOT NULL, kind varchar(16) NOT NULL, created_at timestamp(6) with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT source_tombstone_pk PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, source_kind, source_id), CONSTRAINT ck_source_tombstone_source_kind CHECK (source_kind IN ('ENTRY')), CONSTRAINT ck_source_tombstone_kind CHECK (kind IN ('DELETED_SOURCE')) );

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A redacted entry is a removed source. An entry whose row goes takes its tombstone and the references of the record it is with it. An entry that moves to another account takes the references of its record along.
